title: A group in an icon shows what an icon needs, not page layout rows
goal: Picking a group in an icon fills the panel with page layout rows (Arrangement, Hug and Fixed, Padding, Scale) that mean nothing in a drawing, and they push the animation rows down. Someone drawing an icon should see only rows that change their icon.
notes: Seen three times now: audits of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 (icon-place-tag-1-box-sc.png) and 9-grouped in the-whole-icon-workflow-walk. Picture: queue/audits/2026-11-07-icon-workflow-group-panel-sc.png. Not a bug, a panel that speaks about the wrong job; the panel rows are not covered by the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its, which moves one-shot buttons.
acceptance: A group picked on an Icon picture or in an icon frame shows no Layout section at Next defaults
A shape picked there shows no Columns section
Layout still shows for a group on a Design picture

log.note: Reproduced on the probe before the fix: a group on an Icon picture showed Layers, Color, Effects, Motion, Layout; a shape in a 24 icon frame showed Columns on Frame and Layout. Fix: PhotonzDocument.isAllDrawnInAnIcon (core, IconPanelRowsTests, 5 tests) feeds EditorState.pickIsDrawnInAnIcon, which keeps .placement off the panel; columnsTargetFrameID is nil for an icon frame, so Columns and Layer > Show Columns both go. Gated on next-icon-frames (on at Next defaults). Chose to hide Layout for the icon frame itself too, because its Contents rows (Arrangement, Hug) mean nothing for an icon either; Frame stays. Chose 'every picked layer in an icon' over 'any' so a mixed pick keeps the rows the outside layer needs. Pictures looked at: 1-group-on-an-icon-picture (Appearance, Effects, Motion only), 2-shape-in-an-icon-frame (Arrange kept, no Columns or Layout), 3-group-on-a-picture (Layout present), whole workflow 9-grouped (ends at Motion). Walks run green: new walk plus the-whole-icon-workflow, the-whole-icon-workflow-on-a-frame, screen-columns, columns-follow-the-screen, a-picked-icon-shape-names-its-place, a-glyph-takes-the-saved-stroke. Full Scripts/test.sh green. Rough items in the audit are notes only, nothing filed.

A group or shape picked in an icon (Icon picture or icon frame) no longer shows Layout or Columns at Next defaults; a group on an ordinary picture keeps Layout. Core rule isAllDrawnInAnIcon with 5 tests; panel and Columns target read it. Verified by the new walk a-group-in-an-icon-shows-no-page-layout-walk (no flags) plus 6 related walks green, full Scripts/test.sh green.
